statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low while Stress is extreme ahead of a dense U.S. data-and-Fed sequence.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; Tail remains below the block threshold, with the main conditional risk window around the U.S. cash open and the 14:00 UTC survey-and-Fed cluster.
headline: Nasdaq futures pause after Monday’s AI rally as event risk builds into the U.S. open
body: U.S. index futures are broadly steady after Monday’s AI-led rally, while oil and Treasury yields have retreated from earlier highs. Fresh granular NQ pullback and extension evidence is limited, so persistent mean-reversion failure is not established. ADP, the cash open and Fed events keep Stress extreme.

lookbackSummary: The prior 24 hours captured Monday’s trend-up phase, with Tail peaking at 38% at 19:00 UTC, followed by rapid normalization after the cash session. Overnight and European-morning assessments then stayed mostly low, with one 21% WATCH hour at 04:00 UTC.
outlookSummary: Tail stays below the block threshold before the U.S. open unless persistent near-extreme holding or failed retracements emerge. Conditional risk concentrates at 13:30–15:30 UTC around the cash open and 14:00–14:20 UTC event cluster, then can de-escalate if price discovery becomes two-way.

forecast.analysis: Index futures are broadly steady after Monday’s AI rally, while oil and yields have eased. Fresh granular NQ structure is limited, so persistent mean-reversion failure is not established.
drivers: Flat broad futures; granular NQ path evidence is limited

news.title: Tech stocks rise on renewed AI fever; higher oil, bond yields temper rally
Treasury yields dip as oil price retreats

forecast.analysis: Premarket participation should deepen. WATCH is conditional on a directional push with shallow pullbacks; rotation or deeper retracements would keep Tail contained.

news.title: Tech stocks rise on renewed AI fever; higher oil, bond yields temper rally

forecast.analysis: ADP NER Pulse is due at 12:15 UTC. Stress rises, but Tail stays WATCH unless the release aligns with repeated extension or failed retracements.
The 13:30 UTC cash open falls here. Elevated Tail requires opening-auction continuation, near-extreme holding or repeated extension after failed pullbacks.
drivers: 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open and opening-auction structure

forecast.analysis: Richmond surveys, Williams at 14:05 UTC and Jefferson at 14:20 UTC cluster here. Tail is elevated only if observed price discovery becomes persistently one-way.
After the event cluster, Tail stays elevated only if the first move keeps extending after failed retracements; two-way discovery would de-escalate risk.
By midday, Tail can return to WATCH if price discovery is two-way. Near-extreme holding with weak counter-moves would keep the path more dangerous.
Barkin is scheduled at 17:00 UTC with Q&A. The event adds Stress; Tail remains WATCH unless it reinforces an already persistent directional path.
drivers: Tom Barkin remarks and Q&A at 17:00 UTC

forecast.analysis: After Barkin, conditional Tail eases if two-way trade returns. Continued extension with weak retracement would be the main reason to remain cautious.
Power hour begins at 19:00 UTC. WATCH reflects late-session continuation risk, but a block still requires actual failed pullbacks or closing-near-extreme behavior.
The cash close occurs at 20:00 UTC. Balanced closing flows would reduce path risk; a close at an extreme after failed retracements would preserve it.
drivers: 20:00 UTC cash close and closing-auction balance

forecast.analysis: CME equity-index futures enter 21:00–22:00 UTC maintenance. Tail is low because continuous price discovery pauses; the reopen gap is the next checkpoint.
Globex reopens at 22:00 UTC. Tail stays low unless an abnormal gap is followed by persistent extension with little retracement.
Early Asia liquidity is thinner. Tail remains low unless the reopen move persists through the handoff with aligned technology, rates or oil.
With Asia established, Tail is low if trade is rotational. A one-way move would need repeated extension and shallow pullbacks before changing the assessment.
No major U.S. catalyst is identified in this hour. Tail stays low unless NQ begins holding near an extreme with weak counter-moves.
drivers: Overnight directional efficiency and session extremes

forecast.analysis: As Asia progresses, generic volatility mainly affects Stress. Tail needs failed mean reversion plus stronger cross-market alignment.
drivers: Asia cross-market alignment without assumed path persistence

forecast.analysis: Late-Asia positioning sets up Europe. Tail stays low unless a directional move survives pullbacks and carries through the regional handoff.
Ahead of Europe, liquidity broadens. Tail remains below WATCH unless price is stretched near an extreme and European flows reinforce it.
drivers: Europe pre-open liquidity and near-extreme holding

forecast.analysis: European pre-open flows can challenge the overnight move. Rejection favors mean reversion; repeated extension would raise later-session Tail.
European cash liquidity is active. Tail stays just below WATCH unless regional flows produce sustained efficiency with shallow pullbacks.
European follow-through is the test. Mean reversion keeps Tail low; multiple failed pullbacks would raise risk into the later U.S. handoff.
By European mid-morning, Tail reaches WATCH conditionally. No future path is assumed; escalation still requires observed persistence.
The Europe-to-U.S. lead-in raises sensitivity. Tail is WATCH while the threshold still requires observed near-extreme holding or failed retracements.
drivers: Europe-to-U.S. lead-in and later premarket liquidity

forecastDetail.comment: Broad futures are steady and granular NQ structure is limited; current Tail remains low.
Premarket WATCH is conditional on shallow pullbacks and directional efficiency.
ADP raises Stress; Tail needs persistent extension to move beyond WATCH.
Cash-open risk is elevated only if opening continuation resists retracement.
The 14:00–14:20 UTC cluster is the peak conditional window; Tail requires observed one-way follow-through.
Post-cluster Tail remains elevated only while the first move resists retracement.
